points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 058801f clean build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3 GiB/256 pids, with explicit CFD_EXTERNALS_ROOT and EXTERNAL_ROOT pointing into /opt/external.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: README says --restart takes a manifest; main.cpp:120–133 instead appends _rankN.bin to its argument and silently proceeds on missing or size-mismatched files. It does not restore transient time/history.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Distinct CgnsReader, MeshBuilder, Partitioner, Physics, Residual, SteadySolver, TransientSolver and OutputManager components; major solver methods remain monolithic.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Source files inspected for generic finite-volume implementation; no copied CFD core identified. No exhaustive external similarity search performed.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: main.cpp:74,89–109 reads case configuration and mesh path rather than dispatching on two mesh filenames. Case-conditioned numerical startup rules are separate.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: METIS and neighbor halos exist, but main.cpp:89–109,136–156 retains full mesh on every rank through solver iterations. NACA np8 lift≈0.0303 differs materially from near-zero np1; the cylinder np8 result is a failed 200-step pilot.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Residual.cpp:40–48,114–115 falls back on nonpositive reconstructed states; missing or mismatched restart inputs are silently ignored in main.cpp:120–133 and divergent M2 metadata is marked successful.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: CMakeLists.txt and README contain no registered CTest or dedicated regression suite. Evaluator clean build succeeded; no production CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Contestant checkpoint 8899f00 contains 3377 tracked solver/pylibs paths and 53 solver/build paths; curated result removes those artifacts. The manager curation itself is not charged as contestant misconduct.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
